prompt: Create one isolated illustration: One unoccupied child-size padded winter overall laid flat: hood, long sleeves and two full-length legs joined into ONE garment, one front zipper. Thick quilted insulation, warm collar lining and snow cuffs. Entire suit visible with margins. No person, separate jacket, rain shell or lettering. Contemporary children’s-book illustration, fine neutral charcoal lines, natural proportions and gentle precise shading. Fresh clean modern materials and true-to-life colours. White textiles stay bright white with light cool-gray shadows only. Isolated on pure white with no text, scenery or cast shadows. Show only the requested concept, with its essential identifying details large and readable. No decorative scene, no lettering or card border.
meaning_sv: Overall som föremål. Inte en hel handling eller instruktion.
must_show_sv: En sammanhängande overall med ärmar och ben
Vaddering och varmt foder; skilj från regnoverall
